      "parameters": {
        "extension_distance": "5 cm"
      },
      "target": "Black lever sticking out toward the front",
      "relational_constraint": "Prolong the lever in its existing outward, front-facing direction.",
      "unresolved_reference": "Identify the black front-projecting lever in the CAD model and resolve its existing longitudinal extension direction and end geometry.",
      "target section code": [

        "Localize the target as Section S12, Operating lever. The multiview images show a long black cylindrical hand lever attached coaxially to the brew group, clearly distinct from the smaller angled steam wand in Section S10. Its functional description as a moment arm for manipulating the brew mechanism also matches the requested intention.",
        "Select the free planar end of the lever grip, face code 0121 corresponding to FACE 529, Lever top cap. Use the axis of the adjacent cylindrical grip face code 0120, corresponding to FACE 528, to define the existing outward longitudinal extension direction.",
        "Do not modify the attached lower operating shaft, conical shoulder, or brew-group interface. Preserve face codes 0122, 0118, and 0119 so the lever remains coaxial with and attached to Section S09 without changing its operating pivot or load-transfer geometry.",
        "Create a datum plane coincident with the existing free end face 0121 and normal to the axis of cylindrical face 0120.",
        "Create a sketch on that datum plane and project the circular perimeter of face 0121. Constrain the projected circle concentrically to the existing lever axis and preserve the current main-grip diameter.",
        "Extrude the circular profile outward from face 0121 by 50 mm in the direction away from the conical shoulder and lower operating shaft. Use an additive or join operation so the extension becomes part of the existing S12 lever solid rather than a disconnected component.",
        "Alternatively, where direct face editing is supported, apply Move Face or Offset Face to planar face 0121 by 50 mm along the cylindrical axis. This extends cylindrical face 0120 parametrically while maintaining its diameter and coaxial relationship.",
        "Recreate the free-end treatment on the displaced end. Preserve the existing planar cap if no edge treatment is present; if the source edge contains a small chamfer or fillet, apply the same size to the new terminal circular edge for consistent handling and appearance.",
        "Regenerate the assembly and verify that the main grip length has increased by exactly 50 mm while the lower shaft, conical shoulder, and attachment to the brew group remain unchanged.",
        "Check the extended lever through its intended operating range for interference with Section S03, Main U-frame enclosure, Section S08, Control panel and indicators, and the front removable panel assembly. Confirm that the added length improves hand access without contacting the enclosure or obstructing the dispensing bay."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "intention": [
    "Improve manipulation of the lever."
  ]
}

Continue this process until the task is complete, or you reach the maximum number of iterations. Load it from args["input_file"] rather than hard-coding a path. For these cases, you might need to print out debug information once the model is loaded in your first iteration.

Return a json object with three fields. Do not include any other text outside of the json object in your response:
'complete': true if the task has been completed. IMPORTANT: This should only be judged by looking at the output from the last iteration, not whether a function has been returned this iteration. If there is no valid output that corresponds to the instruction, the task is not complete. The first iteration can never be complete. If this is true, then the current function will NOT be executed, and the function from the last iteration will be used.
'my_cad_function': CadQuery python function as a string. Use the same definition and arguments as the example.

Edit the existing model according to the provided instructions.
Prolong black lever sticking out to the front by 5cm for better manipulation.
CadQuery text output from last iteration:

def my_cad_function(args):
    input_file = os.path.expanduser(args["input_file"])
    model = cq.importers.importStep(input_file)
    shape = model.val()
    print(f"Model valid: {shape.isValid()}")
    print(f"Assembly bbox: {shape.BoundingBox()}")
    solids = shape.Solids()
    print(f"Solid count: {len(solids)}")
    for i, solid in enumerate(solids):
        bb = solid.BoundingBox()
        print(
            f"SOLID {i:02d}: volume={solid.Volume():.3f}, faces={len(solid.Faces())}, "
            f"bbox=({bb.xmin:.3f},{bb.ymin:.3f},{bb.zmin:.3f}) to "
            f"({bb.xmax:.3f},{bb.ymax:.3f},{bb.zmax:.3f}), "
            f"size=({bb.xlen:.3f},{bb.ylen:.3f},{bb.zlen:.3f})"
        )
    return model
